summary.text: Phil GiaQuinta is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 80 who has represented the district since 2006 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is the House minority leader and a utilities services manager with Fort Wayne City Utilities.

paragraphs.text: GiaQuinta holds a bachelor's degree from Indiana University-Bloomington.
His professional experience includes working as a utilities services manager with Fort Wayne City Utilities and as a district manager with the Bureau of Motor Vehicles.
He took office in the Indiana House in 2006, previously served as assistant minority leader, and began serving as House minority leader in 2018.
